scripts.android:build: pnpm --filter @irodoru/app exec tauri android build --target aarch64 --features desktop
scripts.ios:build: pnpm --filter @irodoru/app exec tauri ios build --features desktop
scripts.models:export: uv run --project pkgs/engine/script python pkgs/engine/script/export_onnx.py --out models --models anime
scripts.verify:web: pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm build:web
scripts.verify:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked --workspace
scripts.verify:export: uv run --project pkgs/engine/script python -m unittest discover -s pkgs/engine/script -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.verify: pnpm verify:web && pnpm verify:rust && pnpm verify:scripts && pnpm generate:check
